## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the material substrate of a creative work or copy — print, e-ink, optical disc, server object; the [dcterms:medium](http://purl.org/dc/terms/medium) bridge.

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with the publishable format ([`gmeow:hasManifestationFormat`](gmeow-hasManifestationFormat.md) — 'paperback' vs its 'print' medium) and avoid using it to climb the WEMI spine.

### How to use

- Point the work or carrier at a [`gmeow:CarrierMedium`](../classes/gmeow-CarrierMedium.md) individual; for a single copy, pair with [`gmeow:hasCarrier`](gmeow-hasCarrier.md) on the [`gmeow:Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md).

### Examples

- ex:myCopy [`gmeow:medium`](gmeow-medium.md) [`gmeow:mediumPrint`](../individuals/gmeow-mediumPrint.md).
